{{Quote|The Malastare system includes three gas giants. Name the remaining planets that have more than one moon.''"<br />"''Malastare and... Cogalle!|A [[Computer/Legends|computer console]] and a young [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]]|<ref name="WM">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>}}
'''Bingsang''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Striar/Legends|Striar]] in the [[Malastare system/Legends|Malastare system]],<ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Dustig sector/Legends|Dustig sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Bingsang had sixteen [[Moon/Legends|moons]]<ref name="EA" /> and was one of the three [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] in the system.<ref name="EA" /><ref name="WM" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Malastare system/Legends|Malastare system]], except [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], were first introduced in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
